title: Ask the person in the live execution panel
description: Ask a task clarification or confirmation in DSphere using the same runtime sheet as semantic execution. The external agent still plans. Do not ask these browser-task questions in the caller chat. Returns pending immediately; use page.ask.wait until answered or cancelled.
guidance: Do not enter secrets, grant yourself consent, or continue page actions while pending or declined. Clarifications have no automatic answer; unanswered confirmations decline after the runtime countdown. No action is executed by this method.

inputSchema.description: A task-scoped runtime question or wait request.

pageContextId.description: The task page context from dsagent.page.open, dsagent.pages.list or a receipt's destinationPageContextId.

kind.description: Clarify missing details or confirm a described effect.

question.description: The actual question or confirmation summary shown to the person.

options.description: Optional choices for a clarification; free text is also allowed.

effect.description: Required for confirm: the concrete action awaiting confirmation.

outputSchema.description: Runtime question state and its answer when settled.

requestId.description: The opaque runtime question identity returned by page.ask.

status.description: Pending waits for the person in DSphere. Only an answered accepted response permits the requested continuation.

publishedAt.description: Runtime question publication boundary in epoch milliseconds.

answeredAt.description: Runtime validated response boundary in epoch milliseconds; use with answeredBy to distinguish person response from a safe default.

response.description: The runtime answer, available only after the question settles.

requestId.description: The opaque runtime question identity returned by page.ask.

accepted.description: The person accepted, or the declared safe default declined.

answer.description: Bounded clarification answer from the person.

answeredBy.description: The person or the runtime safe default.
